hooks.command:
other_changes=$(git status --porcelain -- . ':(exclude)logs/operations.md' ':(exclude)DASHBOARD.md' ':(exclude).index/**' 2>/dev/null); log_changed=$(git status --porcelain -- logs/operations.md 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$other_changes" ] && [ -z "$log_changed" ]; then reason="Repo files changed but logs/operations.md was not updated (per CLAUDE.md convention):
$other_changes"; jq -n --arg reason "$reason" '{decision:"block",reason:$reason}'; else exit 0; fi
